items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Eddie, he started with us on trombone, playing a vowel trombone.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . where we came from, where I used to play. Eddie, he started with us on trombone, playing a vowel trombone. Right to him up. Come here, he played there a while, left there, went Chicago. But he came right on back home, he died at home.
When did he come back home?
